name: What is the process for a bathroom vanity and cabinet upgrade with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a bathroom vanity and cabinet upgrade with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for bathroom vanity and cabinet upgrades typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. We then provide a detailed proposal and design plan. Once approved, we schedule the project, managing all aspects from demolition to installation of new vanities, cabinets, countertops, and fixtures. We ensure clear communication throughout the project, culminating in a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction. Our goal is a smooth and efficient renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, design, proposal, project scheduling, installation, and a final walkthrough to ensure satisfaction.
